SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
CONFIDENTIAL
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY 1080 No. 19 8 41）

S.1, Special Branch....51444. File No.................... Date......August 13, 1941.

SUBJECT: R.H. ('Nick') Boyle and H. Kerrey.

R.H. ('Nick') Boyle came to Shanghai some twenty years ago. Boyle is a native of Newcastle, Australia, aged about 40, and arrived in Manila in 1920/1 as a member of the crew of a sailing vessel. He left for Shanghai early in 1922.

His conduct while in Manila may be summed up in the following extract from a report of the Manila Police:—

"The reputation of Jack Boyle, alias Nick Boyle, in this community is very poor. He sponged on his friends for support while in Manila and sometimes took part in boxing matches, invariably losing. During his stay in Manila he was associated with the worst element."

The above extract more or less describes Boyle's subsequent career in Shanghai where he has remained ever since, with the exception of about a year in 1933/4 when he was Consular Policeman attached to the British Consulate-General in Hankow. Boyle has been in and out of jobs. He worked on the Shanghai & Hongkew Wharf for a time and two years ago was with Jardines on their Bund pontoon. However he was discharged from this position owing to malfeasance.

Some six weeks ago, he was brought to Central Station for being drunk and whilst detained over night kicked through a portion of the wire netting of the detention cell. He was not charged on this occasion. Later at the instance of the Anzac Society he was sent to Hongkong for the purpose of

（左侧方框内文字：Commr. of Police. Sir: Information W Duncan 14/8. A. C. (S. B.)）

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 14 AUG 1941）

（印：FILE 19.8.41）

（手写批注：Copy of this report submitted to "Father" Mann last Sunday evening. 18.8.41）

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处登记处 1080号 1941年8月19日）

S.1，特别支部....51444。档案号.................... 日期......1941年8月13日。

事由：R.H.（“尼克”）博伊尔和 H. 克里。

R.H.（“尼克”）博伊尔约在二十年前来到上海。博伊尔是澳大利亚纽卡斯尔人，年龄约40岁，于1920/21年间作为一艘帆船的船员抵达马尼拉。他于1922年初离开马尼拉前往上海。

他在马尼拉期间的行为可概括为马尼拉警方报告中如下摘录：—

“杰克·博伊尔，又名尼克·博伊尔，在本社区的声誉极差。他在马尼拉期间靠朋友接济度日，有时参加拳击比赛，但总是输掉。在马尼拉逗留期间，他与最恶劣的分子混在一起。”

上述摘录大致描述了博伊尔随后在上海的生涯，除1933/34年间约一年时间担任驻汉口英国总领事馆的领事警察外，他一直留在上海。博伊尔的工作断断续续。他曾在上海与虹口码头工作过一段时间，两年前在怡和洋行位于外滩的浮码头上任职。然而，他因行为不端被解雇。

大约六周前，他因醉酒被带到中央捕房，并在夜间拘留期间踢破了拘留室铁丝网的一部分。此次未对他提出指控。后来，应澳新协会的要求，他被送往香港，目的是

（左侧方框内文字：警务处处长。先生：情报 W 邓肯 8月14日。助理总监（特别支部））

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处处长办公室 1941年8月14日）

（印：档案 1941年8月19日）

（手写批注：本报告副本已于上周日晚提交给“父亲”曼恩。1941年8月18日）

H (Harry) Kerrey, British, aged 46 is a
professional piano player. He came to Shanghai
about ten years ago and has worked in various local
bands playing in cabarets, cafes etc. He indulges
in alcoholic bouts from time to time and is quite
unfit for work on these occasions. He is now
unwanted by bands and can only get employment as
a solo player.
It is understood that he is working at present
in the establishment of Madame Helen Piper, 427
Great Western Road as a pianist.
His name does not appear in Police records
and very little is known regarding his activities.

R. W. Macadie.
D. S. I.

H（哈里）·克里，英国人，46岁，是一名
职业钢琴师。他约在十年前来到上海，
曾在当地的各个乐队工作，在歌舞厅、咖啡馆等地演奏。
他不时酗酒，在此期间完全无法工作。目前
各乐队已不再需要他，他只能以独奏者的身份受雇。
据悉，他目前在西大西路427号海伦·派珀夫人
（Madame Helen Piper）的场所担任钢琴师。
他的名字未出现在警方记录中，对其活动知之甚少。

R. W. 麦卡迪。

The Australian and New Zealand Society
of
Shanghai

CONFIDENTIAL
August 7, 1941.
TELEPHONE 50056

Captain H. M. Smyth, O.B.E.,
S.M.P.

Dear Malcolm,

I wonder if you have anything on record concerning the following chaps:
R. H. (Nick) Boyle !
H. Kerrey, c/o Navy Y. M. C. A.
Boyle's address I don't know, but believe he lives in Hongkew.
My reason for asking for information is that we (The Australian & New Zealand Society) are more or less saddled with these two fellows and I hear, through devious routes that, although out of employment, they are in the habit of getting drunk and it rather looks as if our slender funds are being wasted on them!
Neither Bowden nor I have seen them other than sober, so I would like a check on the adverse reports before taking any action.

With apologies for bothering you,
Yours sincerely,

Gothur Mann

GHM/lc

1941年8月7日。
电话 50056

H. M. 史密斯上尉，O.B.E.，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

亲爱的马尔科姆：

不知你处是否有关于以下两人的记录：
R. H.（尼克）·博伊尔！
H. 克里，转海军青年会。
我不知道博伊尔的地址，但相信他住在虹口。
我询问此事的原因是，我们（澳新协会）或多或少被这两个家伙缠上了，而且我通过曲折的途径听说，虽然他们失业，却习惯酗酒，看来我们微薄的资金正浪费在他们身上！
鲍登和我所见到的他们都是清醒时的样子，因此在采取任何行动之前，我想核实一下是否有不利报告。

抱歉打扰你，
此致，

戈瑟·曼恩

GHM/lc
